summary: Electrovaya Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Management Information Circular dated January 15, 2026, for its annual general meeting scheduled February 27, 2026. Routine items include annual financial statements, auditor appointment, director elections, a majority voting policy, an increase in shares issuable under the Stock Option Plan, and a proposed redomiciliation from Ontario to Delaware. The board solicits proxies; no special-situation transaction, stake, or price is disclosed. Watch shareholder dissent rights and tax consequences of the domestication proposal, not deal arbitrage.
